title: Anduril editorial pair
description: Two flat colour bands side by side (stacked on phones), olive then stone grey: a 32px heading with a small ↗ link at the right, a hairline, a 1.8:1 image with 2px corners, and a big light "part" label ("Pt — 01 / 02") hanging over the image's bottom-right edge. As each band scrolls in, the heading and link slide in from the left, the hairline draws from the left, the image slides in further and the label follows.
notes: each band's colour is a tone: accent (olive, light text) or secondary (grey, dark text)
